originality.rationale: Closest full primary text (Talar 2023/2024) explicitly leaves four possible degree-nine numerical profiles; the present geometric flex-consumption argument eliminates three. Distinct topological and constructive inflection-tangent sources do not imply the freeness exclusion. Query-based priority evidence is limited, so older implicit or unindexed coverage remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently worded paper could have proved the same incidence exclusion.
A theorem implicit in a longer treatment of elliptic flex arrangements might imply the conclusion without explicitly listing weak profiles.
The remaining numerical profile may itself be impossible; the present theorem neither proves nor assumes its existence.

value.rationale: Eliminates all degree-nine free arrangements with one cubic and six lines and three of four genuinely open necessary numerical profiles in the primary literature, leaving a rigid two-cubic common-flex geometry. This is a meaningful structural restriction on the top degree allowed by the freeness inequality, not a routine table relabeling or arbitrary small computation.
